text:
Alex W: Hey team — wrapping up my onboarding task: about to open my first PR (feat/checkout-retry). Quick run-through: which local checks should I always run, branch naming conventions, and who to tag for reviews?
Maya P: welcome! :wave: locally we usually run `npm ci && npm run format && npm run lint && npm test` (or `./gradlew check` for Java services). Husky hooks are in place but run the commands manually when changing multiple files.
Ben T: branching shorthand: `feat/` `fix/` `chore/` `infra/`. Keep it compact: `feat/checkout-retry`. If it ties to a ticket add the number like `feat/1234-checkout-retry`.
Zoe R: reviewers: check CODEOWNERS first. For API/SDK ping @Maya, for infra/runtime ping @Ben and me. Otherwise tag `@devex` for a general sweep.
Alex W: sweet. PR body: do we have a template? and what's our merge workflow (squash vs rebase)?
Maya P: template sits in `.github/pull_request_template.md`. Include: summary, testing steps, rollout/backout notes, perf impact. Paste this small checklist in the body:
```- Summary
- Tests added/updated
- Lint/format passed
- Migration/backout notes (if any)
```
Ben T: merging rules: small fixes use rebase-and-merge. New features prefer squash-and-merge for cleaner history unless upstream asks to preserve commits. If you want it squashed add `SQUASH` to the title.
Zoe R: add `area:` labels (e.g., `area: api`, `area: infra`) — CI automation relies on them for routing.
Alex W: I'm hitting an auth error running tests: missing REDWOOD_TEST_KEY. Is there a secrets onboarding step?
Maya P: grab `~/.redwood/env` from the onboarding vault link in #help. If you don't have vault access ask people-ops. Devex-bot can point you to the request page.
devex-bot: To request vault access open an IT ticket at https://redwood.okta/vault-request and include your manager's name.
Ben T: pro tip: run `tools/prep_pr.sh` before pushing. It runs format, lint-fix, and a quick smoke test locally. Saves reviewer time.
Alex W: cool — one last thing: commit message format?
Maya P: follow Conventional Commits: `feat(scope): short description` or `fix(scope): description`. Example: `feat(checkout): add retry for payment intent`. Put issue refs in the body if present.
Alex W: thanks all — I'll run the prep script, open the PR, and ping @Zoe for review once CI passes. :raised_hands:
Zoe R: happy to review! drop the PR link here when ready and I'll take a look after CI.
